required_fields.scenario_id: Stable identity. Lowercase ASCII, dot/dash/underscore separated, no path separators.
required_fields.scenario_version: Exact-match version string, MAJOR.MINOR. Part of run metadata and replay identity.
required_fields.goal: Operator-readable goal statement. Not a controller target.
required_fields.semantic_actions: Non-empty list of semantic ActionType values. Never joint, velocity or torque values.
required_fields.required_adapters: Non-empty list of semantic adapter capability names, for example motion, perception, mcu.
required_fields.evidence_policy: Which observations and ActionResult fields are required before verification.
required_fields.verifier: Repository-relative entry point owned by the World Model verifier layer.
required_fields.recovery_policy: Declared recovery behaviour. Absent means no recovery policy is claimed.
required_fields.evidence_status: One value from evidence_status_vocabulary. Fixtures are never release eligible.
required_fields.non_goals: Explicit statements of what this scenario does not claim.

optional_fields.task_id: Existing TaskGraph identifier when the scenario migrates an existing task family.
optional_fields.world_version: Simulation world contract the scenario was authored against.
optional_fields.owner: Team accountable for the scenario rule, adapter, evidence and release decision.

diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_DUPLICATE_ID: Two manifests declare the same scenario_id and scenario_version.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_FORBIDDEN_FIELD: A field names raw control, trajectory or stop authority.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_ACTION: semantic_actions contains a value outside the semantic ActionType set.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_ADAPTER: required_adapters is empty or names an unknown capability.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_EVIDENCE_STATUS: evidence_status is outside the declared vocabulary.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_ID: scenario_id does not match the stable identity pattern.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_VERIFIER: verifier entry point is not a safe repository-relative path.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_INVALID_VERSION: scenario_version is not an exact MAJOR.MINOR version.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_MISSING_FIELD: A required contract field is absent.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_OVERSIZED_VALUE: A string or list exceeds its bounded length.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_PENDING_ACTION: semantic_actions names an action declared by a future issue.
diagnostic_codes.SCENARIO_UNKNOWN_FIELD: A field is not part of the v1 contract.

ownership.validated_at: registry load, before Event Store initialization

ownership.concern: verifier entry point and verification status
ownership.validated_at: verify() call, at evidence read time
adapters return the shared ActionResult contract
run record creation, before the first event is written
